LESSON: HAJJ

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.4: Hajj

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Hajj
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the prerequisites for the performance of Hajj?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain different types of Hajj to fulfil the requirements for each
2. describe the procedure of performing each type of Hajj for its validity
3. appreciate Hajj as a pillar of Islam
